name: Compensation Response 1
definition: Specifies whether or not the compensation request is granted.

Granted.name: Granted
Granted.definition: Code expressing the decision taken relative to the request for compensation.

InitialAmount.name: Initial Amount
InitialAmount.definition: Compensation calculated for the request before charges have been deducted.

PaidCharges.name: Paid Charges
PaidCharges.definition: Charges deducted from the initial amount.

AmountDue.name: Amount Due
AmountDue.definition: Compensation due for the request after charges have been deducted.

ExpectedValueDate.name: Expected Value Date
ExpectedValueDate.definition: Value date on which the compensation is expected to be paid.

Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Date range for which the compensation applies.

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Interest rate of a financial instrument used to calculate the compensation.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the compensation response.
